parole.testo: Likely an Oghuz borrowing or perhaps Chagatai, ultimately from Proto-Turkic *tikü (“piece”). Compare Karakhanid تِكُو (tikǖ, “piece, slice”), Ottoman Turkish تیكه (tike, “piece”), Turkish tike (“piece”), Azerbaijani tikə (“piece”).

Early attestations in Persian include Anvārī and Khāqānī from the mid-1100s. A Wanderwort of unknown origin, but probably immediately borrowed from Oghuz.
